accuracy_screen.initial_profile_note: Fo_nu=0 can pass trivially because the initial numerical and analytical profiles agree; use the first positive-time result when interpreting transient solver accuracy.

ml_task.generalization_warning: These 1,071 samples represent one physical parameter, mesh, and time-step configuration; they are a pipeline baseline, not a generalization dataset.
ml_task.target_semantics: Analytical reference velocity normalized by moving-wall speed.

run_metadata.analytical_error_convention: Deterministic numerical-minus-analytical discrepancy; normalized by U for percentages and RMSE.

gradient_method.implementation: numpy.gradient with edge_order=2; centered differences internally and second-order one-sided edges
gradient_method.interpretation: Descriptive resolution indicator only; it does not prove that a coarser grid is accurate.

run_metadata.impulsive_start_corner_convention: At t=0 the interior is at rest while the moving-wall boundary value is U.
run_metadata.initial_condition: u(y,0)=0 for 0 <= y < H; moving-wall value is imposed at y=H
run_metadata.mesh_refinement_status: Not assessed: this input contains one spatial grid and one time step.
run_metadata.physical_model: One-dimensional transient start-up plane Couette flow
